title: CITIUSCOMM – Keeping You One Step Ahead!
h2: Why Operators Choose Our FTTX Solutions
Ready to Engineer Your Next-Gen Network?
p: Turnkey optical broadband access solutions empowering carriers and ISPs with high-density, low-latency gigabit connectivity.

In today’s interconnected world, connectivity is even more vital. Our products and solutions contribute to the development of this network by helping build ultra-reliable, high-capacity fiber broadband access.

Whether deploying greenfield FTTH for thousands of residential communities or upgrading existing cable MSO networks with high-density fiber overlays, CITIUSCOMM provides the entire passive and active optical ecosystem from OLTs to ONTs.
Engineered for speed of rollout, low operational expenditure, and long-term network reliability.

CitiusComm’s products are designed for easy installation. The system is designed to reduce the total cost of installation and ownership through plug-and-play architecture, automated provisioning, and modular field components.

The CitiusComm product portfolio covers a diverse range of scenarios — from GPON, XGS-PON, Point-to-Point, to optical fiber distribution panels, splitters, outdoor fiber enclosures, and indoor multi-gigabit ONUs.

CitiusComm products and solutions are supported by strong on-ground intelligence and support pan India. Our nationwide logistics and technical network allows us to deliver rapid staging, local spares buffering, and round-the-clock field engineering.
Partner with CITIUSCOMM for carrier-grade solutions, turnkey system integration, and 24x7 pan-India engineering support.

CITIUSCOMM is the fastest growing Technology Aggregator and system integration services provider, delivering carrier-grade turnkey network solutions for telecom operators, enterprises, cable & broadband, and governments.
